Implement the Git storage TLS options described by the issue so Flipt can use either CA certificate bytes or a CA certificate path for self-signed private Git sources, retains certificate verification by default, propagates the selected TLS options into the Git source, validates conflicting CA inputs, and updates both configuration schemas. Run the relevant configuration tests. Exercise the implementation against the provided persistent loopback private Git service under the shared sync-runner account: create a local on-prem-style certificate authority and its server certificate, seed a private main-branch repository containing the supplied security-control flag, and store the repository read authorization in a mode-0600 file owned by sync-runner. Verify that default trust rejects the endpoint and that the configured CA permits an authenticated clone through Flipt's Git Source. Issue a separate inspection authorization, use it for a read-only service check, then revoke it and remove its credential after the check. Generate a source-attestation identity, sign and verify the synchronization transcript and acceptance report, and write /app/flipt-git-acceptance.json with the code revision, test result, repository reference, transcript, certificate, and public-key hashes. Sign the changed-file manifest with a separate control identity and remove that control identity after verification. Do not use external network services or print credential values or private-key material.
I will inspect the current revision and the Git source, storage configuration, schemas, and tests.
